descriptions.notStarted: You made a visit to Mrs. Claus wondering about Santa Claus's condition, but she wouldn't tell you anything. Maybe you should go find #bSanta Encyclopedia No.1#k, the one that contains the history of Santa Claus, and read up a bit first.  Then you should go visit her again.
descriptions.inProgress: Thanks to #bSanta Encyclopedia No.1#k, she finally opened up and started talking to you.
descriptions.completed: Truth always prospers! You were able to discover the real reason why Santa Claus disappeared.
